summary: Ask whether at least one item meets a condition.
documentation: some returns true when any element passes the callback test. It stops at the first match and returns false for an empty array.
inputs: An array and a predicate callback.
caution: some answers a yes/no question. It does not return the matching item.
scenarios: Show a warning when any invoice is overdue.
Check whether an order contains a restricted item.
Detect whether a roster has someone available.
title: Raise an overdue flag
problem: Given invoices with overdueDays, return true if at least one has overdueDays greater than 0; otherwise return false.
goal: Use Array.some() or an equivalent approach that demonstrates the same concept.
hint: Check whether some invoice has a positive overdueDays value.
